notes.title: Dude... where were you?
notes.notes:
So... hi.
It's been like 2 months since the last announcement, and it's because I was working on something big!
Not update-big, an ENTIRELY different game-big!

Yeah. Jax: History Repeats Itself is going to be replaced with a BETTER Jax: History Repeats Itself. With much more mechanics, better designs, overall, just BETTER.

The new name is going to be Jax: Broken Circuits. This steam page is soon going to be changed to the new game's branding.

And, if you still have JHRI, you'll automatically get JBC as a replacement! The price is also going to stay the same, 2 dollars for JHRI, 2 dollars for JBC.

Soon(tm)

notes.title: Why no updates!?!?!?!?
notes.notes:
So, there hasn't been an update for JHRI for weeks, months, I don't know.

I'm working on an update which has been postponed a number of times.
I was very busy this week, as my classes ended for the summer, friends have called me for help in stuff, etc..
An update is being worked on right now, and it involves a number of changes, most are pretty big. While I'm not going to spoil it, I'd say that v0.9.0 is coming very soon.

jax xd

notes.title: PBR goes brrrr Update (v0.7.0)
notes.notes:
[h1]Major changes in this one, not enough for a major update (aka game release)[/h1]
The day is getting closer and closer!
Not sure if it will be... soon though (sadly).

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
- Major material changes
- Changed some decals so they actually look good
- Added debris
- Replaced one animatronic, welcome Buster into this game now!
- Added basic save system
CAUTION: New Game will override all previous data (which is probably nothing if you haven't played this update yet)!
- New PBR materials
- New AI controller
- Minor bug fixes
- Changed 6AM text
- Added shift number functionality so that it actually changes
- (hopefully) Fixed animatronic animations
- Added the rest of the Story Mode button functionality
- Fixed something that caused minor lag
- Added framing to the Office window
- Added extra lights to some places in the building

Wow, that's the biggest changelog yet!

notes.title: THE OFFICIAL EARLY ACCESS JHRI RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[h1]It's here faster than I thought[/h1]
Well, the day is here! JHRI is now officially out!
Although it does require a bit more changes before the full version.

Help me out by either replying to this, or posting a (proper) review.

We will be trying to roll out updates monthly, in some cases weekly.

And no I'm not going to post all the changelogs here.
